svg.title: EquiLane report preview
svg.desc: Cream, lilac and mint report with a flying-squirrel mascot. The archived development fixture capture has 254 cases and 2,032 matching inputs. Independent model checks failed with 171 mismatches. The searchable catalog filters cases by name, result type and comparison mode. This image shows the overview and a catalog excerpt, not native CPU evidence.
